item.title: Soba Ulala
item.description: Soba Ulala is a new concept from the Hirohisa team, where it’s centered around house-made soba and how they carry forward their familiar restaurant flavors in a more relaxed a’la carte style. The former Michelin star restaurant will be moving to a new location, and this Thompson Street location converted to this concept. We were in in the Soho area, and I abruptly made the reservation for 5:30 PM for 2 on a Thursday evening at 5:15 PM. Reservations seem fairly easy to get, so thankfully it wasn’t too stressful.

item.title: Soba Noodle Azuma
item.description: I’ve been deprived of noodles in the city for a number of months now. Sure, there are sometimes where I get some Taiwanese noodles, but I also love soba noodles too. I was around the Columbus Circle area, and I was scouring for some alternative ramen places. This one peaked my interest because their specialty was not ramen but soba also known as buckwheat noodles. Buckwheat noodles are supposed to be pretty healthy for you, and on a summer NYC day like today, it seems like a win when opting for cold buckwheat noodles with a cold dip.
